datasets.name: tile1_volume
datasets.query:
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workspace.ravenstack.ravenstack_accounts) AS accounts,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT account_id) FROM workspace.ravenstack.ravenstack_churn_events) AS accounts_with_event,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workspace.ravenstack.ravenstack_churn_events) AS churn_events,
  (SELECT ROUND(SUM(refund_amount_usd), 2) FROM workspace.ravenstack.ravenstack_churn_events) AS refund_usd

datasets.name: tile2_segments
datasets.query:
SELECT
  a.industry,
  a.plan_tier,
  a.referral_source,
  COUNT(*) AS accounts,
  SUM(CASE WHEN e.account_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS with_event,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN e.account_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END), 3) AS event_rate
FROM workspace.ravenstack.ravenstack_accounts a
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT account_id FROM workspace.ravenstack.ravenstack_churn_events) e
  ON a.account_id = e.account_id
GROUP BY a.industry, a.plan_tier, a.referral_source
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5
ORDER BY event_rate DESC, accounts DESC

datasets.name: tile3_accounts
datasets.query:
SELECT
  a.account_id,
  a.account_name,
  a.industry,
  a.plan_tier,
  a.country,
  ROUND(s.arr_amount, 2) AS arr_vigente,
  e.reason_code,
  ROUND(e.refund_amount_usd, 2) AS refund_usd,
  e.preceding_downgrade_flag,
  t.tickets,
  ROUND(t.avg_csat, 2) AS avg_csat
FROM workspace.ravenstack.ravenstack_accounts a
INNER JOIN (
  SELECT account_id, reason_code, refund_amount_usd, preceding_downgrade_flag,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY churn_date DESC) AS rn
  FROM workspace.ravenstack.ravenstack_churn_events
) e ON a.account_id = e.account_id AND e.rn = 1
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT account_id, arr_amount,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY start_date DESC) AS rn
  FROM workspace.ravenstack.ravenstack_subscriptions
  WHERE end_date IS NULL
) s ON a.account_id = s.account_id AND s.rn = 1
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS tickets, AVG(satisfaction_score) AS avg_csat
  FROM workspace.ravenstack.ravenstack_support_tickets
  GROUP BY account_id
) t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
ORDER BY s.arr_amount DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 25

datasets.name: tile4_root
datasets.query:
SELECT
  CASE WHEN e.account_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'has_churn_event' ELSE 'no_event' END AS cohort,
  COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS accounts,
  ROUND(AVG(u.avg_usage), 2) AS avg_usage_count,
  ROUND(AVG(u.avg_errors), 2) AS avg_error_count,
  ROUND(AVG(t.avg_csat), 2) AS avg_csat,
  ROUND(AVG(t.avg_hours), 2) AS avg_resolution_hours,
  SUM(CASE WHEN d.account_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS accounts_with_downgrade
FROM workspace.ravenstack.ravenstack_accounts a
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT account_id FROM workspace.ravenstack.ravenstack_churn_events) e
  ON a.account_id = e.account_id
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT s.account_id, AVG(f.usage_count) AS avg_usage, AVG(f.error_count) AS avg_errors
  FROM workspace.ravenstack.ravenstack_subscriptions s
  JOIN workspace.ravenstack.ravenstack_feature_usage f ON s.subscription_id = f.subscription_id
  GROUP BY s.account_id
) u ON a.account_id = u.account_id
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT account_id, AVG(satisfaction_score) AS avg_csat, AVG(resolution_time_hours) AS avg_hours
  FROM workspace.ravenstack.ravenstack_support_tickets
  GROUP BY account_id
) t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT account_id FROM workspace.ravenstack.ravenstack_subscriptions WHERE downgrade_flag = true
) d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
GROUP BY CASE WHEN e.account_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'has_churn_event' ELSE 'no_event' END

datasets.name: panel_ranking
datasets.query:
SELECT
  a.country,
  COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS accounts,
  COUNT(DISTINCT e.account_id) AS accounts_with_event
FROM workspace.ravenstack.ravenstack_accounts a
LEFT JOIN workspace.ravenstack.ravenstack_churn_events e ON a.account_id = e.account_id
GROUP BY a.country
ORDER BY accounts_with_event DESC

datasets.name: panel_classification
datasets.query:
SELECT reason_code, COUNT(*) AS events
FROM workspace.ravenstack.ravenstack_churn_events
GROUP BY reason_code
ORDER BY events DESC

datasets.name: panel_segmentation
datasets.query:
SELECT
  a.industry,
  COUNT(*) AS accounts,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN e.account_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END), 3) AS event_rate
FROM workspace.ravenstack.ravenstack_accounts a
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT account_id FROM workspace.ravenstack.ravenstack_churn_events) e
  ON a.account_id = e.account_id
GROUP BY a.industry
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5
ORDER BY event_rate DESC
